Who Should I follow in AI?

I often get this question, “who should I be following in AI"?” As an emerging tech analyst, there’s not a day that goes by that I don’t think about this question. 

During the last three years or more, I’ve been following people across social media to follow the AI scoops and insights in so far as it’s actually possible/valuable to do this in real-time, or in my free time.

At the end of the day, social media isn’t the best source however experts, writers and professionals on the ground can still give tremendous information whether you are a: 

Software engineer

Or just anyone in the world interested in these things: 

For a General AI Audience 

I tried to make a solid list that would be the most valuable to a general audience, software engineers, and not necessarily experts but first and foremost the AI curious. This list will be valuable to the general AI enthusiast and those who want to keep up best with what’s going on in AI. 

I hope it’s valuable to someone. These include some of the best Newsletter creators, YouTubers, podcasters, AI tool curators, and writers around artificial intelligence and specifically new ways of understanding Generative AI. 

Who is in the list? 🤗

This list features both some of the best Newsletters on AI and people who make LinkedIn posts about AI papers, advances and breakthroughs. In today’s article we’ll be meeting the first 20, in a list of 150+.
